buyBody: A gold carnation print on white. Floral, but drawn tight enough that it reads as pattern rather than as a garden.
pieceParas: Golf has come round to floral prints and mostly done them badly — too big, too literal, too much. This one is drawn small and repeated tight, so it holds together as a pattern at any distance.
White ground with gold linework, which puts it in the same family as the Classic hat and the clubs without repeating either.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body. Bright natural light — a white ground with fine gold linework goes flat and gray in shade. There is no on-body apparel photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
